messages:
Lena Ortiz: Quick debrief from VeloxHR call — onboarding stalled at 'bulk template import'. They're spiking token usage and worried about the renewal.
Samir Kahn: Are spikes reproducible or one-off experiments?
Lena Ortiz: Reproducible when they push full history in one request. Also noticed some returned artifacts (inconsistent formatting).
Ivy Chen: Could be sequence length + batching. Short-term fix: split history, reduce max_tokens, and set batch_size=1 for heavy jobs.
Samir Kahn: For retention, propose a 10-day 'stabilize and trial' package: temporary cost cap, targeted enablement session, and a low-cost model variant to run parallel.
Lena Ortiz: I like that. Add an explicit 'downgrade corridor' if they decline: Feature-Full -> Template-Lite -> Analytics-Only. Make sure analytics remain available.
Ivy Chen: I'll draft a CSM runbook with a toggle snippet customers can flip in-console to cut 60% of inference cost: {
  "batch_size":1,
  "max_tokens":512,
  "cache_policy":"prefill",
  "model_variant":"qa-8b-rt"
}
Samir Kahn: I'll coordinate with SalesOps for a temporary $400 credit and get approval for the 10-day trial.
CS Bot: Note: account_veloxhr renewal=2025-01-15, health_score=64 -> flagged.
Lena Ortiz: I'll send a one-paragraph email offering the trial + 30-min enablement slot. Will post the copy here for review before send.
Ivy Chen: Also suggest a short cost-sim attached comparing their heavy job on current config vs qa-8b-rt. I can run it today.
Samir Kahn: Owners: Samir -> credit/outreach, Ivy -> cost-sim + runbook, Lena -> customer email and follow-up.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks — if they refuse trial, trigger downgrade corridor and keep a 30-day re-engagement. Will update thread after outbound.
